what: Class NOWAIT (14 cases that give IVT, P02 included): the IVT must now says to start it without waiting for CTA, ECG, troponin or labs other than glucose unless a coagulopathy, thrombocytopenia or anticoagulant exposure is suspected (AHA/ASA 2026). ECG, admission bloods and CTA stay required and in the stop rule: the benchmark has no clock between actions, so 'do not delay IVT' is expressed in the IVT must (class NOWAIT), not by removing the work-up the single final assessment needs.
reason: Partly applied: ECG, troponin and admission bloods stay in the stop rule for the reason given.

what: Class SWALLOW (ruling 6): a must 'Screen swallowing at the bedside with a validated tool before any oral food, fluids or oral medication, and keep nil by mouth until the screen is passed (AHA/ASA 2026)' added to 24 ISCH-STR cases that lacked one, with aspiration precautions where the case has dysarthria (and in P04 for the severe MCA syndrome). Not added to M04, RP01, RP03, RS03 (already present) or RM02, RM03 (no neurological deficit). RS01's must includes aspiration precautions for the dysarthria.

CHA2DS2-VASc corrected to 6 (hypertension, age 65-74, diabetes, female sex, stroke 2; the mild non-stenosing carotid plaque does not count) in the apixaban must and the key evidence. S02's 7 checked and correct (heart failure counts).
